verdict.rationale: Rive's docs describe a built-in AI agent in the Editor that helps users write code, design, and animate, generating scripts, responsive layouts, data models, and animation. The related MCP docs add that AI tools can take over repetitive work such as building complex View Models and large State Machines. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how tasks are delegated and reviewed (scope, limits, approval flow), and any independent or hands-on corroboration that the built-in agent works as claimed.
